digest.component_or_area: CLI framework - parser and route registry
propositions: Define a factory protocol and immutable route registry that describe CLI routes and locate parsers without importing handlers or optional dependencies.

Route records must hold lazy handler/parser-factory references plus metadata (identity, alias, visibility, help, mount/init, confirmation/output, capability) and validate duplicate spellings, illegal collisions, contradictory policies, and malformed references without resolving handlers.
Frozen route records must represent every current CLI spelling, derive legacy policy-set exports with zero shadow-census delta, and exclude retired routes from shipped package source.
Registry construction and route lookup must prove no import of handlers, optional dependencies (pydantic_ai, rebar_reconciler), or non-stdlib modules occurs.

Deterministic help output formatter must guarantee fixed width, consistent command/option ordering, UTF-8 LF line endings, one trailing newline, and compatibility-shaped parse errors without process termination.
